input_law: Double each of the 8192 previously frozen random even-x curve controls; the doubling map sends the 2E input population into the order-r subgroup. Preserve all 8192 points, including any duplicates, and check the subgroup order on the first 256 results.
comparison_rule: Compute low-pivot rank on the 16384 frozen D2+D3 pair samples, the 8192 doubled subgroup controls, and their union. A union rank equal to both constituent ranks gives no quadratic feature distinction on these samples.
claim_boundary: Sampled quadratic row-space comparison under a matching subgroup law; it does not establish degree-three or target-adaptive behavior.
